segments.text: Venus is the hottest planet, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun.
segments.headline: Hotter than Mercury

segments.text: Its surface is about four hundred sixty-five degrees Celsius. Hot enough to melt lead.
Its thick carbon dioxide air traps the heat. Standing there would feel like being nine hundred meters under the ocean.
segments.headline: Crushing pressure

segments.text: And a day on Venus is longer than its year.
It also spins backwards. On Venus, the Sun rises in the west.
segments.headline: Sunrise in the west

segments.text: Tomorrow, the smallest planet, hiding ice right next to the Sun. Next stop: Mercury. Follow, so you don't miss episode thirty-two.
